_: The app's official links (public; Donations and Bug report show them). Empty: not shown. donate: the user names on each platform, the same keys as GitHub's .github/FUNDING.yml; custom: up to four https:// links as { "name": "...", "url": "https://..." }. repo: the official GitHub repository, as https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> (bug reports, downloads, known issues).
